title: Nested shadow roots & Popover stress test
blurb: Stress-tests 1-8 levels of nested shadowRoots combined with a top-layer Popover shadow host, intermediate-root omission, and cross-tree duplicate view-transition-name aborts.
question: How deep can nested shadowRoots view transitions go (1-8 nested shadow roots + Popover API layer) before capture latency rises or duplicate view-transition-name values abort the transition?
result: Listing an outer shadow root does not include nested child roots, and any duplicate view-transition-name across listed roots aborts ready with InvalidStateError; M160 capture latency timings are not verified in Chrome 160.
testedIn: Chrome 153 / Chromium 157 (flag inactive); not verified in Chrome 160

friction.summary: Omitting intermediate nested ShadowRoots silently skips their view-transition-name elements
friction.repro: Set depth to 4+, uncheck 'Include all intermediate shadow roots', and run the transition; middle layers are excluded because participation is non-transitive.
friction.workaround: Walk nested custom-element hosts before calling startViewTransition() and pass every participating ShadowRoot in the shadowRoots array.

friction.summary: Duplicate view-transition-name across light DOM and listed shadowRoots aborts the whole transition
friction.repro: Enable 'Inject duplicate view-transition-name: nest-node-1' and run the transition with layer 1's shadow root listed; transition.ready rejects with InvalidStateError.
friction.workaround: Namespace component transition names (for example with a component prefix or unique instance id) before opting multiple shadow roots into one transition.
